featured_reviews.name: Jeeri Deka
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wow! I just got back from the trip of a lifetime through South Africa with Passport Paradise, and I'm still buzzing from the experience! From the moment we landed in Joburg (as the locals call it), I knew we were in for something special. Our amazing trip leader Neha, who's actually the founder of Passport Paradise, made us feel like family right from our first group Christmas dinner at the 11th floor.

Let me tell you - this wasn't your typical touristy schedule. Sure, we hit the must-sees like Table Mountain, the V&A Waterfront, Cape of Good Hope in Cape Town, but Neha took us to hidden gems that most visitors miss. We found ourselves sipping sundowners at sunset cruise, watching the sun paint the sky in incredible colors. And the food? Don't even get me started on the mouth-watering food!

The absolute highlight had to be our time in Kruger. We stayed at the luxurious Radisson, where we could see Impalas from the room balcony! Our private game drives were incredible - we spotted an incredible amount of wildlife within just two days, and our ranger shared fascinating stories about local wildlife conservation efforts. One evening, we even had a sunset drinks with the Giraffes and Zebras.

Back in Cape Town, we explored the Cape Winelands, enjoying private tastings at iconic estate - Stellenbosch. The sunset cruise around the Cape Peninsula was unforgettable - we even spotted some playful seals and penguins! Between activities, we stayed at absolutely gorgeous hotels, which honestly felt more like living in luxury homes than hotels.

What made everything extra special was Neha's personal touch and attention to details. She isn't just knowledgeable about travelling - she's passionate about it. She knew exactly what she was doing and crafted an memorial experience.

If you're dreaming of exploring South Africa, you absolutely need to check out Passport Paradise. They've nailed the perfect mix of luxury and authentic local experiences. I'm already planning my next trip with them ! 🦁✨

Iceland itself is a dream destination, and Neha and team made it even more memorable with their professionalism, expertise, and attention to detail. I highly recommend them to anyone planning a trip to this stunning country.

featured_reviews.name: Wandering Postcard
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited PSK Lower Parel for my passport renewal & the entire process was incredibly smooth.  I reached 30 minutes early but the staff checked my details & allowed me in right away. At the gate itself, I was guided on the first step to take. At the document quality check counter, I took a while to find my papers. The officer politely asked me to step aside so the next applicant could proceed without delay which I appreciated.  There is a small photocopy counter inside if you miss any document & they accept both cash & GPay. Once you get your token number, you are directed to the booth for document submission & biometrics. After that, there are two more verification steps at separate counters. You will need to wait for your token to be called.  The wait can be long & mobile network is poor inside. However, staff are helpful & friendly & also there is a snacks & coffee counter to keep you going.  Overall, well organized & efficient.

featured_reviews.name: suyog soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
1. An appointment is mandatory to visit the Passport Seva Kendra; without one, you will not be allowed entry.
2. The PSK at Lower Parel is a 15-minute walk from Prabhadevi Station. You will also be able to get a taxi.
3. If you wish to come by car or bike, good paid parking facilities are available here.
4. The PSK at Lower Parel is located just behind the IKEA building.
5. After entering the IKEA building gate, you must go straight, and the PSK office is located on your left side.
6. After receiving the token, it may take 45 to 75 minutes for the passport processing.
7. Keep a photocopy of all the original documents along with it.
8. The staff is very nice and cooperative.

featured_reviews.name: Anjali S
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited the passport office today for the renewal of my child’s passport. While the initial process was simple, the waiting time has been extremely frustrating. I arrived at 12:30 PM and have been waiting for counter C since 1:15 PM.
The staff strength seems very low. Only two staff members are actively working, while others appear to be on leave or taking extended breaks. I also observed staff from Section C moving around in Section B and engaging in casual conversations instead of attending to applicants. This lack of focus only adds to the delays.
It is especially difficult for children to wait for such long periods under these conditions.
About five years ago, when the center was managed by Tata, the service was smooth and efficient. Unfortunately, the current experience is disappointing and feels like a waste of time.
Additionally, for the past hour, only Tatkal applicants are being attended to. It is unfair to make normal applicants wait indefinitely. Proper management should ensure both categories are handled efficiently.
Overall, the process needs improvement in staffing, supervision, and applicant prioritization to avoid causing inconvenience to families.
